NONE: › left in a natural or wild state
未開發的，原始的

example: the image of the West as an untamed wilderness
西部尚是一片未開發荒野的形象
his untamed beard
他亂蓬蓬的鬍子

T: › to remove the knots from an untidy mass of string, wire, etc. and separate the different threads
解開，鬆開（纏結的線繩、金屬線等）
› to make a complicated subject or problem, or its different parts, clear and able to be understood

example: It took years to untangle the legal complexities of the case.
理清該案牽涉到的複雜法律問題，花了很多年的時間。

NONE: › If a supply of something valuable is untapped, it is not yet used or taken advantage of.
未利用的；未開發的
› If a theory or argument is untenable, it cannot be supported or defended against criticism.
（理論或論點）難以捍衛的，站不住腳的
› An untenable situation cannot continue as it is.
（局面）難以繼續的，難維持的

example: If three people in four no longer support the government, isn't this an untenable situation?
如果四分之三的人不再支持政府，這樣的局面就難以為繼了吧？

NONE: › used to refer to a teacher in a college or university who does not have tenure (= the right to remain permanently in a job)
（大學教師）沒有永久職位的

example: Her profile in the college is unusually high for an untenured assistant professor.
作為一個沒有永久職位的助理教授，她在學院裡表現很高調。

NONE: C1 so shocking that it cannot be imagined as possible
難以想像的，不可思議的
› an unthinkable event or situation
難以想像的事件（或局面）

example: Today, we see growing acceptance of gay marriage - something that would have been unthinkable a generation ago.
今天我們對同性婚姻的接受程度越來越高，在上一代的時候這是難以想像的事。
The unthinkable had happened - his secret activities had been discovered by the press.
難以想像的事發生了——他的秘密活動被新聞界發現了。

NONE: › not based on serious thought or an examination of the information
考慮不周的；不動腦筋的；不慎重的

example: What annoys me about these people is their unthinking hostility to anything foreign or unfamiliar.
讓我生氣的是，這些人對任何外來的或是不熟悉的東西都不加區分地懷有敵意。

NONE: B1 not tidy
不整潔的，邋遢的，淩亂的

example: an untidy room
淩亂的房間
She's really untidy at home.
她在家真的很邋遢。

NONE: B2 to unfasten a knot or something tied
解開；鬆開
A1 up to (the time that)
到…時；直到…時
B1 not before a particular time or event
直到…才
A2 as far as
直到…； 到…爲止

example: I was up until three o'clock trying to get it finished!
為了完成工作，我一直熬夜做到三點！
Shouldn't we wait until Antony's here?
我們是不是最好等到安東尼來？
We didn't eat till past midnight.
直到過了午夜我們才吃東西。
Once he starts painting a room he won't stop until it's done.
一旦開始油漆房間，他就不會半途而廢。
You should stay on the train until Manchester and then change.
你應該坐火車一直坐到曼徹斯特，然後再換車。

NONE: › very late
很晚

example: He stays up drinking until all hours.
他喝酒喝到很晚。

NONE: › If you say or shout something until you are blue in the face, you are wasting your efforts because you will get no results.
任憑你磨破嘴皮

example: You can tell her to clean her room until you are blue in the face, but she won't do it.
任憑你磨破嘴皮叫她打掃自己的房間，她也不會去做的。

NONE: › Something bad that is untimely happens unexpectedly early or at a time that is not suitable.
（壞事的發生）過早的；不合時宜的
› If someone has untiring energy, interest, or enthusiasm, their energy, interest, or enthusiasm never becomes weaker.
不知疲倦的；堅持不懈的；永不減弱的

example: We'd like to thank George for his untiring efforts on our behalf.
對於喬治為我們所作出的不懈努力，我們表示感謝。

NONE: › An untitled work does not have a title.
（作品）無標題的
› An untitled person does not have an official title.
（人）沒有頭銜的

example: an extract from an untitled poem
一首無標題的詩的節選
Her solo album, as yet untitled, will be out next year.
她的獨唱專輯，目前尚未命名，將於明年出版。

NONE: › to
朝，向，到（同 to）

example: And the Lord spake unto (= spoke to) him.
上帝對他說了話。

NONE: › used to say that you should only do what you think is right.
只做自己認爲對的事情。
› so great in amount or level that it can not be measured or expressed in words
（數量或水準）難以形容的；無數的；不可計量的；巨大的

example: Words alone cannot convey the untold misery endured by people in these refugee camps.
單單文字是無法形容人們在難民營裡所遭受的極度苦難。

NONE: › not able to be punished, criticized, or changed in any way
不可懲罰的；不許批評的；不可改變的
› not able to be defeated or to be as good as
無法擊敗的；無法企及的
› a member of the lowest social group in Indian society
（印度社會的）賤民，不可接觸者

example: He believed the police would never arrest him, that he was untouchable.
他相信警察不可能逮捕他，他是碰不得的。
Coventry City have proved untouchable this season - they've just won their sixth consecutive game.
本賽季考文垂城隊已經證明是無法擊敗的——他們剛剛取得了六連勝。

NONE: C1 not changed or spoiled in any way
未改變的；原封未動的；未受破壞的
› If food is untouched, it has not been eaten
（食物）未動過的

example: Most of the east coast remains untouched by tourism.
東海岸的大部分地區還沒受到旅遊業的侵擾。
She took a few spoonfuls of soup but left her main course untouched.
她喝了幾勺湯，卻沒有動過主菜。

NONE: › unexpected and not convenient or unpleasant
意外的；事與願違的

example: Unless anything untoward happens we should arrive just before midday.
除非發生意外，否則我們應該是剛好在中午前到達。

NONE: › never having been taught the skills for a particular job
未經訓練的；未受培訓的
› to someone without the skill or knowledge to judge what they see
在外行看來

example: To the untrained eye, most fake diamonds look real.
在外行眼裡，大多數假鑽石看上去和真的一樣。

NONE: › not limited by rules or any other controlling influence
不受限制的；自由自在的

example: Self-governing schools are untrammelled by education authority rules.
實行自治的學校不受地方教育當局的規章約束。

NONE: › An untreated substance is not cleaned and has not had special substances added to protect it or make it safe to use.
（物質）未經處理的
› Untreated illnesses, injuries, people, or animals do not receive medical treatment.
未經治療的

example: This wood is vulnerable to water damage because it's untreated.
這種沒有處理過的木頭遇水會受損。
It is a form of anaemia which is nearly always fatal if left untreated.
這是一種貧血病，如果不進行治療的話會有生命危險。

NONE: C1 not true; false
不真實的；虛假的
› the quality of not being able to be trusted
不值得信任
› not able to be trusted
不值得信任的

example: He is an utterly untrustworthy, unreliable source.
他是一個完全不值得信任、不可靠的消息來源。

C: › [ C ] a statement that is not true
U: › [ U ] the fact that something is not true

example: It's not the first time that the paper has been in trouble for printing untruths about people's private lives.
這家報紙已經不是第一次因捏造人們私生活的新聞而惹上麻煩了。
The untruth of this statement was immediately clear to me.
我立刻就看出來這份聲明是假的。

NONE: unpitched
› having no knowledge of or education in a particular subject
無知的；未受教育的
› if or because you are, I am, etc. an untutored person
在外行看來／在我這個外行眼裡

example: To my untutored eye that just looks like a load of random brush strokes, and yet it's a very valuable painting.
在我這個外行人眼裡，那只是一堆隨意的塗鴉，但它實際上卻是很有價值的作品。

NONE: › not typical
非典型的；無代表性的

example: Her angry outburst was untypical; she's usually a very quiet woman.
她一般不會這樣發脾氣，平時她是一個很安靜的人。
It is not untypical of girls of her age to be concerned about their appearance.
她那般年紀的女孩子一般都很在意外表。
